shortDescription: Bitdeer sold 258.6 BTC this week and maintained zero bitcoin holdings. According to Odaily, the company’s weekly update said it produced 258.6 BTC as of November 6, sold all of it, and had no net additions; its holdings remained at zero, excluding customer deposits.
